text.p: Shares in Abbey National rose on Thursday as investors continued to digest news from the company's trading update earlier this week and analysts at Charterhouse Tilney raised the stock to a "buy" from a "hold".
The shares were 8p at 609-1/2p by 1010 GMT in trade of over one million shares.
Charterhouse Tilney analyst Simon Willis confirmed his change is stance, adding that the stock was "very cheap".
"There were parts of the autumn trading statement that were very encouraging," Willis said.
"The stock has underperformed the rest of the sector by 10 percent over the last three months," Willis said. "I'm looking now for a 10 percent outperformance over the next six months to about 670p."
Willis said there were indications from the bank's trading statement on Tuesday that the loss of new mortgage market share was abating in the second half.
He added that margins were also holding up well.
